Adding the runbook excerpt and smoke commands here so folks can paste into the bridge console. I also attached the ops-playbook-v2.md which contains the exact step-by-step we will run.

Runbook excerpt (ordered):
1) Pre-cutover verification (T-60 to T-15)
   - Confirm routing rules in control-plane: `redwood-route verify --env acme-prod --routes-file routes.json`
   - Snapshot active model versions, record kv-cache TTLs
   - Validate ingress firewall rules / BGP peers: `net-check --peer acme-peer01`

2) Control-room bridge (T-15 to T+120)
   - Open bridge: #acme-cutover (Slack), bridge dial-in linked in Drive (see related_links)
   - Start telemetry sampler: `telemetry-sampler --sample windows 0,10,30,60 --out /tmp/acceptance.json`

3) KV priming (T+0 to T+10)
   - Mirrored traffic approach: run `curl -X POST https://mirror.redwood.internal/prime` with payloads in `ops-playbook-v2.md`
   - Fallback: if cache hit ratio < 60% at T+8m then start targeted prefix seeding: `kv-seed --file prefexes.json --rate 50rps`

4) Smoke tests (T+10 to T+30)
   - Basic generation smoke: POST /v1/generate with short prompts (attached list)
   - Load sanity: 10qps for 5m, measure 95th latency delta < 20%
   - Observability check: ensure traces are flowing to Telemetry (verify via `otel-query`)

5) Post-deploy validation (T+30 to T+120)
   - Consolidate telemetry snapshots and upload postdeploy-log.txt
   - Generate smoke-evidence.zip (screenshots, test traces, sampler outputs)

Notes: keep the control-plane fallback ready: a canary variant (smaller model) is configured in the routing rules to take traffic at 5% if GPU saturation occurs.

Attachment: ops-playbook-v2.md (Markdown, 12KB)

Team —

Short readout from the Saturday 2027-10-10 cutover window: successful. Summary and artifacts below.

1) Outcome
   - Cutover completed at 02:28 UTC. No customer-facing errors reported. Mirrored traffic priming ran for 10m, then targeted prefix seeding for 15m.

2) Telemetry sweep
   - Samples captured at T+0/T+10/T+30/T+60. Key observations: 95th latency +12% (within SLO), KV cache hit ratio moved from 38% baseline to 74% at T+30, GPU memory pressure nominal.

3) Smoke tests
   - Generation smoke passed (all short-prompt checks ok). Load sanity: 10qps for 5m stable.

4) Issues & mitigations
   - Small spike in kernel-miss errors at T+6m — automated fallback to canary routing engaged (5% diversion) and spike resolved within 90s. No rollback required.

5) Artifacts uploaded
   - postdeploy-log.txt (full sampler output)
   - smoke-evidence.zip (traces, screenshots, command outputs)
   - Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xq-example-drive-link

Thanks to everyone on the bridge — Marissa for escalation coordination, Irene for telemetry sampling, Karthik for runbook execution, Ravi/Alice for partnership. I'll open INF-7821 for the follow-on action item to tune cache TTLs.
